title: Lula’s online ‘army’ shows how copying Brazil’s WhatsApp model could backfire on Spain’s and France’s left
lede: With Spain voting on Sunday and France preparing for its 2027 presidential election, the Brazilian 'digital army' experiment appears to offer an appealing solution to the far-right's dominance of online political communication. But there is a problem: barely a month after Lula's victory, his online army has found a new enemy and it’s not the far-right, but the Left itself.

title: EU’s ‘green’ bonds paid for non-green projects, audit finds
lede: Controls implemented by the EU failed to ensure money from green bonds was invested in environmentally-beneficial projects, with some money going towards oil and gas-fuelled assets. The European Court of Auditors interrogated the disbursement of funds in Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Italy, Portugal and Poland.
